items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I knew Ethel Waters and Bessie Smith and Bruce and his grocery store.

ctx.x: She had to sign for him to go. She didn't want him to go, he wanted to go. He enlisted but, he was only seventeen years old. But he liked that idea of the uniforms and all that and the travel. To see, travel and......
Ethel Waters used to go up there and dance her brains out.
And Louis and Ethel used to go up there and dance their brains out. Louis was a good dancer you know.
